title: Extension-owned activation overlay (BEYOND-18)
acceptance_criteria_project: a1 (filing): The defect class (no extension-owned activation/loading affordance) is reproduced by the project's own e2e verification BEFORE the fix — the judge record is filing evidence, not closure evidence.
a2 (filing): Closure evidence attached to BEYOND-18 demonstrating the new affordance (e2e result / build artifact), or a documented product-brief correction where the finding was over-stated scope.

[AC-1].text: [AC-1] **reproduce before fixing.** The absence class is proven by this repo's own instrument on the pre-fix tree — not by re-reading the judge record. Instrument: the production injection list parsed from `js/background.js` carries no activation affordance, and the real host boot exposes no extension-owned loading node. Evidence: the recorded pre-fix run and its result in verification.md §1.

[AC-2].text: [AC-2] **extension-owned affordance.** A DOM node `#be-activation-overlay` exists, mounted before any boot work (ahead of `await Storage.init()`), carrying `data-be-activation-state="active"`.

[AC-3].text: [AC-3] **attribution.** The overlay names the work it is doing ("Enhancing sheet…") AND the extension ("Print Enhancer") — the certified gap was precisely that the only visible spinner belonged to D&D Beyond and nothing told the user an extension had changed the sheet.

[AC-4].text: [AC-4] **dismissal + witnessability.** The overlay is dismissed on completion (state flips to `dismissed`, node retained so a camera can witness both halves), is click- and Esc-dismissible, and never wedges on the re-run-confirmation refusal path.

[AC-5].text: [AC-5] **theme + print integrity.** Styling is owned by the locked theme stylesheet (`js/ui_theme.js`), not a parallel sheet, and the overlay is hidden by the print-reinforcement block.

[AC-6].text: [AC-6] **fail-open.** Evaluating the module without a `document` neither throws nor mounts (the peer module convention that keeps standalone/mjsdom harness boots alive).

[AC-7].text: [AC-7] **on-camera proof.** A captured frame taken while the overlay is `active` passes a self-verifying pixel check (its own box corners are the overlay's backdrop), and a post-boot frame shows it gone. Artifacts attached to BEYOND-18.

[AC-8].text: [AC-8] **no regression.** The full unit/e2e suite and the low-risk smoke set stay green; the dead-export count bump for the new seams is justified in-line where the count is asserted.
